input.issue: I notice that people I assigned the test in October of 2025 have not received new tests. How long do the tests stay active in the system.
input.subject: Test Active in the system

sub_requests: why assigned tests are not received
triage.reasoning: Standard product FAQ about test settings and test delivery.

grounded.response:
Tests in HackerRank remain active indefinitely unless a specific start and end time are defined. If an expiration date is set for a test or an invitation, candidates will not be able to access or receive the test after that time.

If candidates assigned a test in October 2025 have not received new tests, it's possible the test itself or the invitation has expired.

**To check or modify test expiration:**
1. Log in to your HackerRank for Work account.
2. Go to the **Tests** tab and open the relevant test.
3. Navigate to **Settings > General**.
4. Review or modify the **Start date & time** and **End date & time** in the **Test Expiration Time** section.

After a test expires, invited candidates cannot access it, and you cannot invite new candidates.

**To check or modify test invitation expiration:**
1. When inviting candidates, look for the **Expiry** dropdown.
2. Select an expiry option or choose **Custom** to set a specific date, time, and time zone.

After the invitation expiry time, the invitation expires, and candidates can no longer take the test.
grounded.reasoning: Multiple chunks provide clear information on how test and invitation expiration works, and how to modify these settings, directly addressing both sub-requests.
